svg.text: Annual Report RAG on Azure — end-to-end architecture

Ask how something changed between FY2025 and FY2026 of a company's annual report. Each year is searched separately, every figure is checked against that year's extracts, and unverified answers pause for a person.
① BUILD TIME · run once, then after changes
zip the code (never .env, data, tests) → az webapp deploy → wait for /health
config.py every setting · secrets come from .env
azure_clients.py one client per Azure service
tests/ offline: no Azure account, no keys, no cost
run_query.py the same graph from the terminal;
the reviewer answers a / r at the keyboard
Azure App Service · Linux · Python 3.12 · B1
startup.sh → python -u UI/server.py · 1 instance · health check /health
answer · review · rerank chart · Sign out
1 · input_guardrail — safety (personal data, advice) + on topic?
2 · retrieve — hybrid search + semantic ranker, ONCE PER YEAR
3 · rerank — keep the 5 best by semantic score, per year
4 · generate — gpt-4o: FY2025 said · FY2026 said · what changed
5 · output_guardrail — format, then grounding: figures in the right year?
⤷ blocked at step 1 → polite refusal; nothing else runs
⏸ paused runs live in MemorySaver (server memory) until the reviewer answers in the UI
per graph step and per Azure OpenAI call
③ Data in Azure · resource group rg-annual-report-rag · eastus2
Keys and endpoints live in .env (laptop) or the web app's settings (Azure) — never in the code or the zip
Azure AI Search · Basic · index annual-reports · ~5,150 chunks
